caption: The drawing consists of a symmetrical composition featuring a cross, a bow-like shape, wing-like forms, and a circular mandala. At the top, there is a stylized cross with curved edges, colored in shades of brown, red, and light blue, and accented with yellow radiating lines behind its center and arms. Below the cross is a bow shape with four arms outlined in blue and filled with red and decorated with yellow dotted lines. The center of the bow is a small circular element bordered in blue. To either side of the bow are symmetrical wing-like forms in muted yellow with dark red tips. Beneath all of these elements is a large circular mandala, bordered in red and blue, filled with radiating patterns in yellow, red, and blue, resembling petals or sun rays. The entire composition is set against a beige, textured background with a gradient effect around the edges.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
